translated_title: Mexico's Senate Receives Reform to Prohibit Dual Nationality in Presidents and Governors
original_title: Senado recibe reforma para prohibir doble nacionalidad en presidentes y gobernadores
author: SinEmbargo Editorial Staff
meta_description: The proposal amends three articles of the Constitution and stipulates that those with another nationality must renounce it before registering as candidates for president, governor, or head of government.
